_readme: Queue written by the daily-reel-render task, drained by tools/apply_additions.py during tools/sync.bat. The task must NOT edit calendar.md or review-state.json directly - it queues here instead, and sync.bat folds these in AFTER pulling, on top of whatever the desk decided today. That is what stops the two files conflicting. Adds only: an existing calendar row (keyed on date + post title) is left exactly as the desk left it, and so is an existing review-state key - with one exception, the render flip (content: awaiting-render or rerender -> in-review, plus new revisions entries), which is what tells the desk a cut now exists. It can never write an approval; see the module docstring in tools/apply_additions.py.

revisions.changed: Rebuilt from the 09-04 redraft, addressing feedback rounds 1-3 ("We can box out in ultimate using body. Just not using arms") - one complaint captured three times. Copy only: no rules card, rule number or rule text moved. Scene 6 headline "You cannot box out." -> "You can box out - just not with your arms.", and its body rewritten to name the permission before the limit; scene 8 headline "Boxing out is a habit from another sport." -> "Box out with your body, not your arms." with a matching body. The rule is narrow: 12.9 bans EXTENDED arms or legs used to obstruct, its annotation excludes normal running and jumping, and 12.5 - carded on scene 3 of this same reel - entitles a player to occupy any unoccupied position. v1's headline was broader than any rule on screen and broader than its own slide body. Verified rather than asserted: the v1 copy was re-rendered in parallel and the frame sets compared pixel by pixel - of 34 states exactly 5 differ, three on scene 6 and two on scene 8, and scenes 1-5, 7 and 9 are pixel-identical to the rejected cut. Built on reel-31/render_v3.py for the 2026-09-02 _payload() widening; a no-op here, since no line in this reel ends with a double quote. Nine scenes, exact CFR via encode.py, 29.50s - the same as v1, since no line count moved. Layout check 0 problems with no collisions; scene 6's kicker still auto-fits to 32px and its body to 33px; main scenes at max_y 1192 of 1310, detail cards at 604, 754 and 454, field tip 1062. Longest sustained dull-orange run 0.20s against a 0.45s threshold. 12.5, 17.4.1 and 12.9 re-verified character-for-character against rules.json. This cut does not improve on v1 by any measurement - v1 was clean on all of them, and the defect was the words. v1 archived as reel30-blocking-fouls.v1.mp4.
